MODULE: frontend/axis1_context.py -- the PUBLIC Axis-1 local-Lindblad CONTEXT metadata layer:
the frozen dataclass Axis1LocalLindbladContextSpec (a load-bearing __post_init__ that coerces +
validates every rate via the private _finite / _nonnegative_finite guards; the is_trivial /
include_leakage read-only properties; to_manifest / to_metadata JSON-safe emitters; and the
load-bearing to_axis1_primitive_params fan-out that selects spec-vs-defaults per optional rate),
plus the four module-level functions normalize_axis1_local_lindblad_context (dict/spec/None ->
typed spec, popping non-field manifest keys + schema-guarding), axis1_local_lindblad_context_from_
schedule (getattr bridge), axis1_contextual_primitive_names (thermal T1->T1_UP / T1_B->T1_UP_B
expansion), and axis1_contextual_fsim_residual_primitives (residual FSIM_SWAP/FSIM_PHASE gate).
It imports NEITHER torch NOR quimb (dataclasses + math + typing + a sibling mechanisms
Axis1PrimitiveParams whose torch import is lazy/in-function), so EVERY public unit is CPU-PURE
and IN-SCOPE for full L0+L1+L2 -- out_of_scope is therefore {} (the AST reconcile refuses any
gpu_bound claim on a torch-less module -> expect ZERO out_of_scope).
TEN public units (AST reconcile _public_units_in_module: top-level public defs + every public
method of a top-level class INCLUDING the load-bearing __post_init__ dunder + the two @property
methods is_trivial / include_leakage):
* Axis1LocalLindbladContextSpec.__post_init__  -- coerce/validate; raises on bad thermal /
fsim-residual / epistemic_class.
* Axis1LocalLindbladContextSpec.is_trivial      -- 18-way `and` (all fields at default).
* Axis1LocalLindbladContextSpec.include_leakage  -- 9-way `or` (any leak rate > 0).
* Axis1LocalLindbladContextSpec.to_manifest      -- exact JSON-safe dict (incl. epistemic map).
* Axis1LocalLindbladContextSpec.to_metadata      -- {} if trivial else {KEY: manifest}.
* Axis1LocalLindbladContextSpec.to_axis1_primitive_params -- spec-or-defaults fan-out.
* normalize_axis1_local_lindblad_context / axis1_local_lindblad_context_from_schedule /
axis1_contextual_primitive_names / axis1_contextual_fsim_residual_primitives.
The private module-level helpers _finite / _nonnegative_finite are NOT public units (leading `_`),
so the coverage audit does not score them -- but they ARE mutated by mutmut and are exercised
end-to-end through __post_init__ (both `or` operands of the non-negative guard + the finite guard,
tripped at the value==0 boundary and via the non-finite / negative routes with the EXACT message).
L2 DISCIPLINE (100% coverage != discrimination).
* __post_init__: the three raising guards (thermal `include_thermal_excitation and gamma_up<=0`,
fsim `include_fsim_residual and (dtheta==0 and dphi==0)`, epistemic `not in {a,b,c}`) are each
tripped with the EXACT message via assert_raises_exact AND their non-raising legit arcs pinned;
the `<=`/`==`/`and` operators are killed at the boundary (gamma_up==0 valid vs thermal-True
raise; one-angle-nonzero valid vs both-zero raise). _nonnegative_finite is killed at the
value==0 boundary (default valid) + negative-value raise (exact 'must be finite and
non-negative, got -0.5') via BOTH `or` operands; _finite via a non-finite fsim angle (exact
'must be finite, got inf'). The optional-rate ternary (None->defaults vs value->coerce) is
pinned on a None spec (default) AND a value spec.
* is_trivial: the all-default spec pins True; a per-conjunct BATTERY (one field individually
perturbed off its trivial value -> is_trivial False) trips every conjunct's short-circuit arc
(100% branch) AND kills the comparator/`and`->`or` mutants (the gamma_up-only-nontrivial spec
alone flips every `and`->`or` because its single False conjunct sits in the mutated prefix).
* include_leakage: the no-leak spec pins False; a per-leak BATTERY (each leak rate individually
> 0 -> True) trips every disjunct's short-circuit arc + kills the `or`->`and` and `>`->`>=`
mutants (the no-leak False pin kills `>`->`>=` at 0.0; a single-leak True pin kills `or`->`and`).
* to_manifest / to_metadata: the EXACT dict is pinned vs an INDEPENDENT hand-built literal (schema
+ metadata_key hardcoded, NOT imported from src -> a mutated module constant no longer matches;
epistemic_class='b' makes rate_values/leak/fsim-angle classes 'b' distinct from the hardcoded
'a' collapse/hamiltonian-form and 'c' selection literals, so any a/b/c literal swap is caught).
to_metadata pins {} on the trivial spec and {KEY: manifest} on a non-trivial spec.
* to_axis1_primitive_params (the load-bearing fan-out): the returned Axis1PrimitiveParams is
pinned field-by-field vs an INDEPENDENT recompute -- a None-rate spec takes the defaults, a
set-rate spec takes the spec values, gamma_up/fsim angles always from the spec, drive_area/
drive_omega always from defaults -- with assert_discriminates against a wrong-coefficient
variant; the None->defaults ternary is killed (set-rate spec) both ways.
* normalize_*: None/{}/() -> default spec; a spec -> returned by identity; a non-dict (int AND
str) -> exact ValueError; a full to_manifest() round-trips to an equal spec (kills all seven
payload.pop key mutants -- a mutated pop key leaves a non-field manifest key -> **payload
TypeError); an unsupported schema -> exact ValueError, a correct/absent schema -> constructs.
* from_schedule: a schedule carrying axis1_local_lindblad_context (dict AND spec) -> the matching
normalized spec (kills the getattr attr-name string mutant); a schedule WITHOUT it -> default.
* contextual_primitive_names: a thermal-context BATTERY (T1->T1_UP, T1_B->T1_UP_B, dedup when
the _UP name already present in input OR already appended, no expansion for non-T1 names, and
a lower-case name forces the .upper() coercion) pins the EXACT tuple; a non-thermal context
returns names verbatim (kills the `not include_thermal_excitation` route-removal + the two
inner `and`->`or` mutants: a non-T1 name under thermal must NOT gain a _UP).
* contextual_fsim_residual_primitives: residual-off -> (); residual-off-with-a-nonzero-angle ->
() (kills the `not include_fsim_residual` removal); residual-on picks FSIM_SWAP / FSIM_PHASE by
the dtheta!=0 / dphi!=0 arcs (both, and both together), pinned exactly.
REACHABILITY (the D13/D18/D19 default-arg / guard-route lesson -- PROBED through the PUBLIC entry
points, never asserted). Every raising guard is tripped through a real construction/normalize/
schedule route with the EXACT message. Each _nonnegative_finite `or` and the fsim/thermal `and`
guards are probed at the discriminating boundary (value==0 valid, negative/non-finite raise; one
operand true at a time). The seven payload.pop key mutants are probed via a genuine full-manifest
round-trip (a surviving non-field key would raise TypeError at **payload). NO exemptions + NO
out_of_scope: every unit is CPU-pure and every branch is REACHABLE through a public entry point
(checked, not assumed).
